evidence.quote: Micro-Flex large-diameter pipe and tank wrap is a 2.5 pcf (40.1 kg/m 3) density product made from high-temperature, semi-rigid fiberglass blanket bonded to a flexible facing.

Micro-Flex can be installed indoors & outdoors depending on the application. Micro-Flex does require a weather barrier cladding such as aluminum jacketing or polyvinyl chloride (PVC) jacketing to protect it from the elements when installed outdoors.

outdoor_jacket.summary: Outdoors the board goes under an aluminum jacket: UFGS 23 07 00 calls for ASTM B209 H14 aluminum, 0.016 in minimum; round duct outdoors lapped at least 3 in with bands at the laps and at most 12 in apart; rectangular duct outdoors a metal jacket secured with screws. Micro-Flex outdoors needs weather-barrier cladding such as aluminum (U65). Rectangular duct outdoors defaults to JM's rooftop-duct board, XSPECT ISOfoam APF polyiso (U67, U68), tapered on top over 32 in wide; round duct outdoors stays Micro-Flex.

evidence.quote: It is recommended for ductwork over 32” wide that the top surface of the duct work use JM XSPECT Tapered Boards to allow for moisture to naturally run off the duct system and prevent pooling.
The underside of duct work 24” (610 mm) or more wide shall be secured with mechanical fasteners spaced approximately 18” (460 mm) on center.
Use a UL 181A compliant tape or vapor retardant mastic to close all board seams and penetrations to create the additional vapor retarder closure.

Cover insulation with a metal jacket cladding system or weather barrier cladding with a self-stick closure system. For metal cladding systems, follow common industry accepted practices like those described in the MICA Insulation Standards.
